dailyChallenge.title: Hardware Mystery 🧠
dailyChallenge.prompt: Which component inside a CPU specifically coordinates the fetch, decode, and execute cycle rhythm?
dailyChallenge.explanation: The Control Unit (CU) orchestrates the CPU pipeline by decoding instructions and directing the flow of control signals.
